company.name: Ahazou
company.shortDescription: Ahazou is a SaaS platform that helps small and micro businesses to grow online.
company.description: Ahazou is a SaaS app that helps offline local businesses to connect online with their customers to promote their brand, to build their reputation, and to sell more. Their vision is to build the next all-in-one platform for 50 million local businesses to grow online in Latam. Ahazou is backed by GFC, Monashees, Y Combinator (S21), and more.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,371,921 to $9,126,765, a 3.85x increase.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (+3 over 90 days) and market heat at 68 (+2).
